RFC8956-3.1-1.note: Non-compliant: nonzero padding bits emitted. TestIPv6FlowPrefixPatternAndPadding re-encodes received patterns whose padding is 0xff and asserts fs.Bytes() and WriteTo equal the canonical zero-padded bytes (e.g. 0xff -> 0xfe for 72/65), and asserts a configured 2001:db8:ffff::/33 encodes its last octet as 0x80 with host bits cleared. Both polarities present.

RFC8956-3.1-2.note: The quote carries both clauses. Encoding: the canonical-bytes assertions described for RFC8956-3.1-1 go red if padding is emitted nonzero. Decoding: inputs with padding 0xff must parse without error and comp.Prefix() must equal the prefix built from pattern bits only (::7f00:0:0:0/72, 103:8000::/17); a decoder that read padding into the match or rejected nonzero padding fails require.NoError or the Prefix assertion.

RFC8956-3.1-3.note: Out-of-range clause enforced: TestIPv6FlowPrefixRejectsMalformedBounds requires ParseFlowSpec errors for length0/offset1, 64/64, 63/64 and 129/0, and accepts 80/64. The first clause, length = 0 and offset = 0 matches every address, has no assertion in the tagged unit: 0/0 acceptance appears only in TestIPv6FlowPrefixPatternAndPadding (tagged 3.1-1/3.1-2) and nothing asserts it matches every address.

RFC8956-3.6-1.note: Non-compliant: a fragment bitmask encoded wider than one octet. TestRFC8956FragmentSingleOctet encodes a value of ^uint64(0) through IPv6 FlowSpec and VPN producers and asserts the exact bytes {12, 0x81, 0x0e} (len=00, one octet) via WriteTo and Bytes(); the negative requires ParseFlowSpec/ParseFlowSpecVPN to error on a 0x91 (len=01) two-octet operand.

RFC8956-3.6-2.note: Non-compliant: a reserved bit set in an encoded IPv6 fragment operand. TestRFC8956FragmentEncodingRespectsEnclosingFamily adds DF|IsF and asserts the IPv6 and IPv6-VPN encodings carry 2 (DF bit cleared) while IPv4 carries 3; IsF/FF/LF emit 2, 4, 8. High reserved bits are cleared in the 3.6-1 unit (0x0e from all-ones).

RFC8956-3.6-3.note: The quote carries both clauses. Decoding: TestRFC8956FragmentDecodeIgnoresReservedBits parses operands 0xf3, 0xf5, 0xf9, 0xf1 (every reserved bit set) without error and asserts Matches() is IsF, FF, LF, 0; a decoder that kept or rejected reserved bits fails. Encoding: the re-encoded NLRI must equal want with reserved bits zeroed (2, 4, 8, 0).

RFC8956-5-1.note: Non-compliant: a destination with nonzero offset authorizing a FlowSpec route. TestFlowSpecVPNValidationSeparatesAFIAndRD receives an IPv6 VPN FlowSpec with offset 32 under a same-RD covering default and asserts RouteEligible false and no candidates (Fatal 'nonzero destination offset passed IPv6 validation'); the offset-0 destination is authorized by same-RD VPN unicast. The offset check in flowSpecDestination (rib_flowspec_validation.go:118) is shared by SAFI 133 and 134.
